booklet.title: Release GenroApp for macOS: build, sign, notarize, publish
booklet.author: Giovanni Porcari

purpose.p: Produce a GenroApp build for macOS that another Mac opens without a Gatekeeper refusal: a universal app signed with the Developer ID certificate of team HXS58UUB2N, notarized by Apple, with the ticket stapled, published as a disk image and as an update for the installed apps.
The distributed build is the site runner only. It is compiled without the Cargo feature devices: no Python sidecar, no card signing, no PIN window.

list.item: Rust with the targets aarch64-apple-darwin and x86_64-apple-darwin, Tauri CLI 2, Xcode command line tools.
The certificate Developer ID Application of team HXS58UUB2N, with its private key, in the keychain.
The notarytool keychain profile gp-notary-tool of team HXS58UUB2N. It is created once per Mac with xcrun notarytool store-credentials gp-notary-tool --team-id HXS58UUB2N.

The private key of the updater in ~/.tauri/genroapp-updater.key, with no password. It is kept in 1Password, vault "Comuni Softwell", document "GenroApp updater key". Its public key is in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json, plugins.updater.pubkey.
The public key that signs connection files, base64, in ~/.tauri/genroapp-link.pub.b64. It is kept in 1Password, vault "Comuni Softwell", document "GenroApp connection signing key (Ed25519)".
The AWS CLI and the 1Password CLI op, signed in, with access to the item s3-meetlot of the vault gpkube.

step.title: Raise the version
step.p: Set the new version in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json and src-tauri/Cargo.toml. Installed apps see an update only when the version in latest.json is higher than theirs.

step.title: Build and sign
step.p: The script builds GenroApp.app for universal-apple-darwin with --no-default-features. It reads SOFTWELL_LINK_PUBLIC_KEY from the environment, or from ~/.tauri/genroapp-link.pub.b64 when the variable is not set. A build without this key rejects every connection file.

The app is signed with the hardened runtime, a secure timestamp and two entitlements: com.apple.security.device.camera and com.apple.security.device.audio-input. No window of the app uses them since the menus Meetlot and Assistenza were removed. No provisioning profile is embedded.

step.title: Release: notarize, disk image, updater archive
step.code: GENROAPP_RELEASE_NOTES="What changed in this version" macos/release.sh
step.p: The script notarizes and staples the app. It builds GenroApp-VERSION.dmg with the app and a link to /Applications, then signs, notarizes and staples the disk image. It packs the stapled app in GenroApp-VERSION.app.tar.gz, signs that archive with the updater key and writes latest.json. The three files are in dist/release/.
GENROAPP_NOTARY_PROFILE and GENROAPP_UPDATER_KEY replace the default profile and key file.
On a notarization answer Invalid, read the reasons with the submission id:

step.title: Publish
step.p: The script uploads to the bucket genroapp-downloads of the Hetzner Object Storage (endpoint https://fsn1.your-objectstorage.com). op run passes the keys of the 1Password item s3-meetlot to aws s3 cp; they are never printed.

row.cell: the disk image of that version
the disk image of the latest version: the fixed download link
the manifest the installed apps read

step.p: The public address of an object is https://genroapp-downloads.fsn1.your-objectstorage.com/OBJECT. The listing of the bucket answers 403. latest.json goes last: an installed app never reads a manifest whose archive is not there yet.

step.title: How an installed app updates
step.p: A release build reads latest.json at start and every hour. A higher version puts the badge "1" on the Dock icon and the item "Aggiorna a VERSION e riavvia" in the GenroApp menu, under "Informazioni su GenroApp". The item downloads the archive, verifies its signature with the public key in tauri.conf.json, replaces the app and restarts it. A debug build never checks.

step.title: Verify
step.code: APP=src-tauri/target/universal-apple-darwin/release/bundle/macos/GenroApp.app xcrun stapler validate "$APP" spctl -a -t exec -vv "$APP" codesign -dv --verbose=4 "$APP" 2>&1 | grep -E 'CDHash=|Notarization' curl -fsS https://genroapp-downloads.fsn1.your-objectstorage.com/latest.json

row.cell: the new version and the URL of its archive

rule.why: The ticket is bound to the CDHash of one build; a rebuild has another CDHash.

rules.rule: Notarize and staple every new build.

rule.why: Under the hardened runtime macOS denies the camera and the microphone to an app without these entitlements, and shows no permission prompt.

rules.rule: Keep com.apple.security.device.camera and com.apple.security.device.audio-input in the signed entitlements.

rule.why: The release bundle carries no sidecar executable; with the feature on, the app stops at start when it cannot launch the sidecar.
Whoever holds it can publish an update that every installed app accepts.

rules.rule: Write the private key of the updater in a file of this repository.

rule.why: The installed apps accept only archives signed with the key whose public half they carry; without it they cannot be updated, only reinstalled.

rules.rule: Keep the private key of the updater in 1Password, vault "Comuni Softwell".

rule.why: An installed app could read a new latest.json together with an old cached archive, and refuse its signature.

rules.rule: Reuse the name of a published archive for another build.

limits.limit: The build is for macOS only.

The Associated Domains entitlement for passkeys (src-tauri/AssociatedDomains.plist, src-tauri/tauri.passkeys.json) is not in the distributed build: it needs a Developer ID provisioning profile for it.softwell.genropy.runner.
Old versions stay in the bucket until they are deleted by hand.

facts.fact: Apple accepted GenroApp 0.1.0, CDHash 9024c8bf811b3afd58dcbe3e8e2725a0b7749d7b; after stapling, spctl answers accepted, source=Notarized Developer ID.
Apple accepted the disk image GenroApp-0.1.0.dmg; spctl -t open answers accepted, source=Notarized Developer ID.
The executable genropy-runner of the build holds x86_64 arm64.
After publishing, latest.json, GenroApp.dmg and GenroApp-0.1.0.app.tar.gz downloaded over HTTPS have the same SHA-256 as the files in dist/release/; the bucket root answers 403.
